MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

2. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 8

5. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 5

7. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 1

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

14. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

15. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
